title: DosePET: An Open-Source Dataset with 2100 Radiation Dose Maps for PET/CT
abstract: arXiv:2611.34008v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large collections of three-dimensional radiation dose maps linked to patient anatomy are needed to develop artificial intelligence (AI) models for personalized internal dosimetry in nuclear medicine, but access to such data remains limited. Here we present DosePET, an open-source dataset of 2,100 patient-specific absorbed-dose maps generated by Monte Carlo simulation of publicly available PET/CT examinations: 1,503 [18F]FDG examinations from ENHANCE.PET and 369 [18F]PSMA-1007 and 228 [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 examinations from PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions, acquired at five institutions with seven scanner models. For each examination, the CT was resampled to the native PET grid to build a voxelized patient phantom, the quantitative PET image defined the radionuclide source, and radiation transport was simulated with GATE version 9.4. translated_title: DosePET：一个包含2100张辐射剂量图的开源PET/CT数据集
translated_abstract: 开发用于核医学个性化内剂量估算的人工智能（AI）模型，需要与患者解剖结构相关联的大型三维辐射剂量图数据集，但目前此类数据的获取仍然受限。本文提出DosePET，这是一个开源数据集，包含通过蒙特卡洛模拟对公开可用的PET/CT检查生成的2,100个患者特异性吸收剂量图：其中1,503例[18F]FDG检查来自ENHANCE.PET数据集，369例[18F]PSMA-1007检查和228例[68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11检查来自PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions数据集，数据采集自五个机构的七种扫描仪型号。对于每次检查，将CT重采样至PET原始网格以构建体素化患者体模，定量PET图像用于定义放射性核素源，并使用GATE 9.4版本进行辐射输运模拟。器官和组织掩膜通过TotalSegmentator从CT图像生成。每个研究文件夹包含一个NIfTI格式的剂量图……
tldr: 本文发布了DosePET，一个包含2,100例基于公开PET/CT检查经蒙特卡洛模拟生成的患者特异性辐射剂量图的开源数据集，为核医学个性化内剂量AI模型的开发提供了宝贵的数据资源。
en_tdlr: DosePET is an open-source dataset of 2,100 patient-specific radiation dose maps generated via Monte Carlo simulation of publicly available PET/CT examinations, providing a valuable resource for developing AI models for personalized internal dosimetry in nuclear medicine.
